title: North Carolina and Georgia school-therapy pilot research
method: Primary district, charter-network and official procurement evidence. RFP dates establish historic purchasing; they do not establish a currently available order, current shortage, award or rolling enrollment. Recommendations are analyst judgments.

state_summary.recommendation: Conditional shortlist for a 2027-28 or permitted supplemental pilot; no open school-therapy entry route was verified in the reviewed targets.
state_summary.rationale: Wake supplies unusually clear purchasing evidence and a softer experience preference; a single CSUSA school offers the clearest documented small-scope design. Durham and Johnston have company-reference barriers. Treat Triangle-area clinician availability and achievable margins as unverified.
critical_gates: Written confirmation of lawful entry outside the expired solicitation
Acceptability of a new agency's references
Named available clinicians and feasible school travel
Current awarded rates and payment terms

state_summary.recommendation: Secondary research market. Reviewed therapy awards are closed; one live MSP competition is too broad for a first 1-3 therapist prime contract.
state_summary.rationale: Cherokee has an established 28-vendor program through 2029, and Whitfield is awarded. Griffin-Spalding preserves separate specialty purchasing discretion, offering a discovery hypothesis rather than a proven entry route.
critical_gates: Retrieve current eligibility and award terms
Obtain written permission for district-data AI use where required

districts.name: Wake County Public School System
districts.demand_evidence: 2026 addendum prioritizes SLP; estimates prior-year use of about 30 SLPs, 21 OTs and one COTA. These are historical utilization estimates, not current vacancies.
districts.procurement_status: RFP 251-27-99 deadline expired; current award roster and supplemental-entry permission not verified.
districts.entry_route: Published competitive RFP via NC eVP. Verify next solicitation or expressly permitted supplemental route before selling a pilot.
districts.incumbents: 2025-26 table names AMN, EDU Healthcare, Kinetic Pediatric Therapy, ProCare, Soliant, Speech Inspirations, Speech Masters, Stepping Stones and others; not a verified 2026-27 award list.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Two years' experience preferred; references required. Consistent agency identity across registration, insurance and invoices; district interviews/background checks. EOR naming mismatch explicitly rejected.
districts.pilot_fit: Conditional medium-high: multi-vendor structure, expected 12-15 awards, and short/long coverage support limited scope; no 1-3 clinician minimum or guarantee established. One-year term plus two optional annual extensions at same cost.
districts.supply_economics: Prior-year hourly customer rates published; not current achievable prices or clinician pay. Monthly invoices and firm-renewal pricing warrant cash and wage-sensitivity analysis. Current recruitable supply unknown.
districts.modality: Mostly in person; virtual considered where specified.
critical_gaps: Clinician availability and current unit economics
districts.recommendation: Best NC district discovery target, contingent on an entry route and staffing evidence; not a live bid recommendation.

districts.name: Durham Public Schools
districts.demand_evidence: RFP 179-2526-268 explicitly addresses SLP/OT/PT staffing shortages. It welcomes agencies and managed-service providers.
districts.procurement_status: Expired solicitation. eVP says no longer accepting responses and Pending Selection; award section exposes no verified winner. Portal status may lag operations.
districts.entry_route: Next solicitation or confirmed approved subcontracting/supplemental route. Current RFP permits subcontracting with prime accountability; that does not authorize a new subcontract now.
districts.incumbents: eVP lists bidders including Ampersand, AMN, eLuma and others; bidders must not be labeled awardees.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Three company references of similar scope/size; licensed and screened clinicians. Under-five assignments add specified early-childhood clearance. Assistant/fellow supervision expected.
districts.pilot_fit: Medium operational fit, weak immediate entry. Explicit multiple awards; district assigns caseloads and provides system onboarding. Scope targets 2025-28, while standard term starts at award for three years plus two options: executed agreement needed.
districts.supply_economics: 37.5-hour week with approximately 25-30 direct/consultative hours specified. Customer rates, current openings and recruitable supply unverified.
districts.modality: In person only; DPS-approved records platforms.
districts.recommendation: Second-wave district or approved-partner discovery; reference burden and closed route weaken a new agency's first direct pilot.

districts.name: Charter Schools USA North Carolina managed schools — single-school pilot
districts.buyer_type: Charter-school network procurement, not one conventional district
districts.demand_evidence: 2026 RFP covers eight schools, including Union Preparatory Academy, Steele Creek Preparatory Academy and Cardinal Charter Academy at Cary.
districts.procurement_status: Closed annual RFP; award and later entry not verified.
districts.deadline: 2026-04-30 17:00 stated EST (past; document weekday label is inconsistent)
districts.entry_route: Regional RFP; verify a future annual cycle or authorized supplemental purchase.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Company profile, description of experience over the last five years, three current references, licensed clinicians and screening. Do not interpret experience-description request as a verified five-year minimum.
districts.pilot_fit: High scope fit: explicitly allows bidding selected schools and selected clinical services. Consider one school with 1-3 SLPs only after needs and contracting approval are confirmed.
districts.supply_economics: 2026-27 contract period; hourly proposals requested. Actual rates, guaranteed volume, clinician supply and travel costs unknown.
districts.recommendation: Strong small-scope discovery alternative if charter schools are acceptable; no verified open route.

districts.name: Johnston County Public Schools
districts.demand_evidence: 2026-27 RFP seeks additional SLP/SLPA services, capped at 40 hours per provider weekly; not a count of open placements.
districts.entry_route: Bidder mailing list and future procurement; registration is not contracting approval.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Demonstrated school-staffing success and three school/district references for similar projects completed within three years; NC references preferred.
districts.pilot_fit: SLP-only scope and possible individual-service awards fit a focused offering. Prior-company-project requirement weakens a first direct bid.
districts.supply_economics: Price weighted 34%; experience and reputation each 22%. Net 30 after correct invoice/acceptance. Current prices and available clinicians unknown.
districts.modality: School-setting services; virtual eligibility unverified. District Medicaid documentation required.
districts.recommendation: Secondary watchlist or approved-partner discovery; not a current bid.

districts.name: Cherokee County School District
districts.demand_evidence: SSCS-2026 procurement covered district student-support staffing. Award establishes a purchasing relationship, not an unfilled placement.
districts.procurement_status: Awarded June 19, 2026 to 28 vendors; official GPR status Awarded.
districts.entry_route: Current supplier program already awarded. Next competition, formal addition or approved partnership would require district confirmation.
districts.incumbents: Award includes Amergis, Soliant, ProCare, eLuma, Huddle Up and local specialists including CBR Therapy Consultants, Golden Oak Therapies and Speech Teachers of North Georgia.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Solicitation sought experienced agencies; full eligibility/reference conditions not verified in the accessible primary award record.
districts.pilot_fit: Existing specialty winners demonstrate supplier diversity, but do not prove a new 1-3-clinician supplier may enter. Award term July 1, 2026-June 30, 2029.
districts.supply_economics: Current clinician availability, awarded rates and allocated volumes unverified.
districts.modality: Exact purchased modality and records requirements need executed scope.
districts.recommendation: Benchmark and renewal watch; low immediate direct-entry fit.

districts.name: Whitfield County Schools
districts.demand_evidence: Official procurement covers OT, PT, SLP, interpreters and nursing staffing.
districts.procurement_status: Official GPR status Awarded; attached signed scoring matrix is scanned and winner details were not reliably extracted.
districts.entry_route: Expired competitive procurement; no rolling or supplemental therapy entry route verified.
districts.incumbents: Awardee identities unverified; do not infer them from aggregator lists.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Exact company-experience, reference and staffing-capacity gates unverified.
districts.pilot_fit: Research-only: discipline-specific and 1-3-clinician participation not established.
districts.supply_economics: Current rates, quantity, term and available clinicians unverified.
districts.recommendation: Do not select over better-evidenced pilot targets; obtain award and solicitation packet first.

research_limits: No outreach, registration or application was performed.
No current therapist candidate availability or negotiated wage evidence was obtained.
Expired purchasing evidence is useful for fit and requirements, not evidence that the buyer will accept a new supplier now.
Public bid tabulations identify bidders, not winners or active incumbents.

adjacent_live_leads.name: Griffin-Spalding County School System
adjacent_live_leads.procurement_status: Official GPR status Open as of 2026-10-20; RFP 27-104 questions closed October 15.
adjacent_live_leads.demand_evidence: District seeks a special-education managed-services provider across 16 scored staffing categories. This is an opportunity to compete, not a guaranteed service order.
adjacent_live_leads.entry_route: Live broad MSP RFP. Section II separately reserves district discretion to contract individual, small-business and specialty providers. A narrow SLP pilot is therefore a discovery hypothesis, not an established open procurement.
adjacent_live_leads.new_entrant_requirements: At least three public-school district references of similar scope and size; firm K-12/Georgia/special-education experience narrative. Prime must price each staffing category and perform employer-of-record, recruitment, compliance and reporting responsibilities.
adjacent_live_leads.pilot_fit: Poor first MSP-prime fit; potentially useful specialty discussion after procurement rules and authority are confirmed. Initial term execution through June 30, 2027.
adjacent_live_leads.ai_constraint: Section XIX requires prior written district authorization for district-data use in AI, machine learning, analytics or model development.
adjacent_live_leads.recommendation: Do not rush a broad MSP bid. Research the explicitly reserved specialty-provider route.
